instruction: Add more_itertools.argmin(iterable, *, key=None) and argmax(iterable, *, key=None), exported from the package: the index of the first occurrence of the minimum (maximum) value of the iterable, comparing key(item) when a key function is given. argmin([3, 2, 1, 0, 4, 2, 1, 0]) is 3, argmax([0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 2, 1, 0]) is 3, argmin('efghabcdijkl') is 4, argmin([10, -2, -20, 5], key=abs) is 1. Any iterable works, including generators; an empty iterable raises ValueError.
